# Kamunity Reflection
## Community Self-Perception Infrastructure

**Purpose:** A Kai-centred conversational mirror that helps community organisations discover what they're actually for — and find others facing the same fork in the road.

**What it does:**
- Asks organisations "What are you for?" through guided conversation
- Surfaces gifts (reframes), earworms (memorable phrases), and peer stories
- Identifies value exchange possibilities: swaps, loops, and chains between organisations
- Leaves something useful in hand when the conversation ends

**Primary users:** Community organisations in WA — peer support groups, mental health sector, arts/community orgs, ACCOs.

**Key principle:** "You can stop anytime. What you have is already yours."

**Part of the Kamunity ecosystem:**
- Main site: https://kamunity.org
- Sovereignty Audit: https://kamunity-audit.netlify.app
- AI Readiness: https://kamunity-ai-readiness.netlify.app
- Consulting: https://kamunityconsulting.com

**Built by Kamunity** — post-capitalist community infrastructure, Whadjuk Noongar boodja, WA.

**Kai is:** An AI wayfinder — not a counsellor, not a professional advisor. Honest about being AI. Always pointing toward human connection.
